title: Grateful Dead Live at Family Dog at the Great Highway on 1970-02-28
venue: Family Dog at the Great Highway
lineage: SBD > MR > Cass > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a varied 1970 show highlighted by a Lovelight sandwich and a standout Mason’s Children jam.
ai_review.review: The recording is a clean sound‑board mix with crisp instrument separation and excellent dynamics, though the acoustic interlude was cut short by monitor problems. Musically the concert offers a nice variety – an early Lovelight opening, a brief but superb acoustic set (Little Sadie, Black Peter), and a second half that builds to a fiery Mason’s Children and The Other One, with Alligator and extended drum work adding extra excitement.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers (average ★4.4) praise both the performance and the recording; only a few notes of minor flaws keep the rating just below the top tier.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, well‑balanced soundboard tape with clear instrument definition (especially bass). Excellent dynamics and mix, though monitor issues shortened the acoustic segment.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Unusual set order starts with a fresh Lovelight opening, followed by a short acoustic sandwich that sets a relaxed mood before the electric second half ramps up through Alligator, The Other One and culminates in an extended Mason's Children jam.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Opening Lovelight described as crisp and energetic; no specific criticism of his playing.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass praised for clarity and tightness – “not thumpy, but taught.”
band_member_comments.Drums: Drum duo highlighted as strong, especially the extended excursions between Alligator and The Other One.
